{{Quote|You must initiate the self-destruct sequence. The generators in the lower tunnels... can be set to overload...|The seargent's last words|<ref name="OAA1">''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]] break into the base of the [[Ardan resistance]]by blowing up a wall. [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] shoot fleeing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], including a [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] tasked with destroying the base by overloading generators. He dies soon after being shot, but manages to tell someone about his mission.<ref name="OAA1" />
